method: Manual application of handoff/G5-narrative_vs_numbers.md v1. Three actual performance statements selected from the real Q3 and Q4 FY26 BSE packages. This tests metric matching and abstention with the actual delivered report; no extra release figures supplied.

ship_decision: Hold the public module. Abstaining on all three is correct, but it yields no investor-facing comparisons from this pair and snapshot. Supply period-, currency- and basis-matched actuals with resolvable primary page references, verify speaker identity and semantic support, and run an end-to-end provider test. Keep the earlier release-based positive controls as separate fixtures.
